children.name: Moringa arborea Verdc.
children.description: Moringa arborea is a species of flowering plant in the family Moringaceae that is native to Ethiopia and Kenya.

children.name: Moringa borziana Mattei
children.description: The native range of this species is Ethiopia to E. Kenya. It is a tuberous subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Moringa concanensis Nimmo
children.description: The native range of this species is Pakistan to W. India. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Moringa drouhardii Jum.
children.description: Moringa drouhardii, the bottle tree or maroseranana, is an endemic species of southwest Madagascar.

children.name: Moringa hildebrandtii Engl.
children.description: Moringa hildebrandtii, or Hildebrandt's moringa, is a tree species with a massive, water-storing trunk in the family Moringaceae.

children.name: Moringa longituba Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Ethiopia to N. Kenya. It is a tuberous subshrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Moringa oleifera Lam.
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Pakistan to NW. India. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Moringa ovalifolia Dinter & Berger
children.description: Moringa ovalifolia is a succulent flowering tree of the family Moringaceae native to Namibia and southwestern Angola.

children.name: Moringa peregrina  Fiori
children.description: Moringa peregrina is a species of flowering plant in the family Moringaceae that is native to the Horn of Africa, Sudan, Egypt, the Arabian Peninsula, and as far north as Syria.

children.name: Moringa pygmaea Verdc.
children.description: The native range of this species is NE. Somalia. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Moringa rivae Chiov.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & SE. Ethiopia to S. Somalia and N. Kenya. It is a tree and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Moringa ruspoliana Engl.
children.description: The native range of this species is E. & S. Ethiopia to Somalia. It is a caudex shrub or tree and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Moringa stenopetala  Cufod.
children.description: Moringa stenopetala, commonly known as the African Moringa or cabbage tree, is a deciduous tree in the plant genus Moringa, native to Kenya and Ethiopia.
